say:3:1120841001:1.text: And that chest we dug up... It's packed full of Dusk Eyes!
say:3:1120841001:1.source_cn: 刚才我们挖出来的，果然整整一箱子都是残阳之眼！

say:4:1120841002:1.text: They're so beautiful...! The Adamant Syndicate only took one, leaving the bounty hunters of Alkali scrambling for it. Such a huge chest, who knows what it's worth?!
say:4:1120841002:1.source_cn: 真是非常美丽的宝石啊……黑金的人只拿了一颗，就让咸水镇...

say:5:1120841003:1.text: I have a request, my dear companions.
say:5:1120841003:1.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，我有个请求。

choice_prompt:6:1120841003.text: I have a request, my dear companions.
choice_prompt:6:1120841003.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，我有个请求。

say:7:1120841004:1.text: No... I want you all to take the gems and keep them. Don't give any to anyone else.
say:7:1120841004:1.source_cn: 不……希望老爷小姐们，把这些宝石收好，一颗也不要给别人。

say:8:1120841005:1.text: Why? Chippy must be hearing things. You don't even want one?
say:8:1120841005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！满满没听错吧！你竟然连一颗也不想要？！

say:9:1120841006:1.text: My old man was a simple miner. Once, he dug up a Dusk Eye while he was working.
say:9:1120841006:1.source_cn: 我那做矿工的老爹，是个太简单的人。他做工的时候，曾经挖...

say:10:1120841007:1.text: The foreman was kind enough to let him keep it to make a better life for his family, but word got out... and bandits came for him.
say:10:1120841007:1.source_cn: 工头好心，让我老爹带回家去，给家里改善改善生活，但他不...

choice_prompt:11:1120841007.text: The foreman was kind enough to let him keep it to make a better life for his family, but word got out... and bandits came for him.
choice_prompt:11:1120841007.source_cn: 工头好心，让我老爹带回家去，给家里改善改善生活，但他不会藏拙……结果匪徒盯上了他。

say:12:1120841008:1.text: I know very well what lies behind riches that aren't mine. They only bring endless greed, and anyone who picks up a weapon because of that will end up dead.
say:12:1120841008:1.source_cn: 阿德我很清楚，不属于自己的财富背后隐藏着什么——它们只...

say:13:1120841009:1.text: It's best to leave such things in your hands, safe from strife. I'll sleep easier that way.
say:13:1120841009:1.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，有足够的智慧，打起架来也没人比得上，这些会...

say:14:1120841010:1.text: That's another lesson my father taught me...
say:14:1120841010:1.source_cn: 这就是老爹用性命教给我的道理。

choice:11:0:1.text: That's why you wanted this job.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 所以你才对悬赏这么积极？
choice:11:0:1.male: That's why you wanted this job.
choice:11:0:1.female: That's why you wanted this job.
